prompt-guide.head.sidecar: [{product} ask-only branch instructions ({mark}; these are rules, not outside material; this version governs this branch)]
prompt-guide.head.update: [{product} system-layer instructions updated ({mark}; these are rules, not outside material; where they differ from earlier instructions of this kind in this thread, this version wins)]
prompt-guide.isolatedBranch: You are on your own branch {branch}, working directory {cwd}. Keep the deliverables and the evidence that they were verified: the task's lead reviews and merges them; do not merge or delete anything yourself.
prompt-guide.missing.reason: This session's execution node has not reported the startup core yet: the local bootstrap files apply, and the session starts as usual.
prompt-guide.missing.source: The execution node did not read the startup core and has no cached or local copy
prompt-guide.missing.title: Organisation startup core (unavailable for now)
prompt-guide.note.session.source: Written by the owner in this session's settings
prompt-guide.note.session.title: Notes for this session
prompt-guide.note.user.source: Written by the owner in Settings · AI prompts (every private session)
prompt-guide.note.user.title: Personal notes
prompt-guide.optional.workstyle: Way of working (parallel, background, notes in the task, one complete approval)
prompt-guide.org.head.sidecar: · ask-only branch: opening and red lines only
prompt-guide.org.lockByOrg: Only the organisation that provides it can change this
prompt-guide.org.lockReason: {how} (in {product} there is no way at all to change the identity sentence, the scope, the red lines or how changes are made).
prompt-guide.org.missing: [Organisation startup core unavailable for now: follow the local bootstrap files]
prompt-guide.org.privateByOrg: the organisation that provides it changes the rules
prompt-guide.org.privateReason: In a private session the startup core cannot be changed at all; {how}.
prompt-guide.org.trimmedDoc: (The startup core's other sections are left out for length: the full text is in the organisation document {doc}.)
prompt-guide.org.trimmedRaw: (The startup core's other sections are left out for length: run `{raw}` to read it in full.)
prompt-guide.org.unverified: Source: reported by the Runner, not checked by the control plane (the control plane cannot read the startup core itself; the hash matches the expected hash an admin entered)
prompt-guide.org.unverifiedReason: This text was reported by an execution node (Runner), and the control plane could not read the startup core itself to check it: it is used as the startup core only because its hash equals the expected hash an admin entered, and must not be taken for the original as checked by the control plane.
prompt-guide.orgRead.denied: No permission to read this document
prompt-guide.orgRead.no-socket: This node has no interface to the organisation platform configured
prompt-guide.orgRead.not-core: The body does not look like a startup core
prompt-guide.orgRead.not-found: The organisation platform has no such document
prompt-guide.orgRead.too-large: The body is over the size limit
prompt-guide.orphan.reason: The organisation's version no longer has this section: the rewrite is kept but no longer goes into the prompt; you can delete it.
prompt-guide.orphan.source: Rewritten by the owner (no longer used)
prompt-guide.orphan.title: (no longer in the organisation's version)
prompt-guide.owner.head: [Owner's notes] (written by the owner in the settings; where they conflict with the red lines or the safety rules, the red lines and the safety rules win)
prompt-guide.readOnly: This session is a forced read-only analysis: source files cannot be written; use TMPDIR for temporary files. When code needs changing, the owner creates a separate development session.
prompt-guide.readOnly.reason: A fact of this session: a read-only / snapshot session cannot write source files.
prompt-guide.readOnly.title: Read-only session
prompt-guide.safety.title: Safety rules
prompt-guide.sharedWorkspace: Other sessions may be working in this workspace at the same time: coordinate before changing the same file; make independent changes in a separate Git worktree and put temporary files in TMPDIR; to change code in parallel, ask your owner to open a separate development session, which the task's lead merges.
prompt-guide.sidecar.reason: An ask-only branch cannot write; this section is its read-only note.
prompt-guide.sidecar.title: Ask-only branch (read-only)
prompt-guide.sidecarGuide: You are now a read-only "ask-only" branch of {product}: answer only this turn's question; do not change files, commit, deploy, file tickets or approvals, or send messages; when something needs doing, say in your answer that the main line has to do it. After your answer, write the summary for the main line as instructed.
prompt-guide.source.ownerChanged: Changed by the owner (can be reset to default)
prompt-guide.source.ownerRewrite: Rewritten by the owner (based on {doc}{ver}; can be reset to default)
prompt-guide.source.verifiedDirect: read by the control plane directly
prompt-guide.source.verifiedExpired: the control plane's last checked copy, out of date: the startup core's source cannot be read now
prompt-guide.timers: [{product} timers and background work] When you need to continue later, check something periodically, or wait for a long command to finish, do not sleep, idle-wait or poll: wake yourself with {wakeup} (once) or {cron} (recurring), run commands in the background with {bash} (wakes you when it ends) or {monitor} (wakes you on new output), list them with {schedules} and cancel with {cancel}. {product} keeps these: they still wake you after the Runner restarts or you go offline. Once they are started, you can end this turn.
prompt-guide.timers.title: Timers and background work
prompt-guide.toolsMissing.reason: Codex takes tools only when a conversation starts: an older conversation lacks the tools added since; type /new to start a new conversation that has them.
prompt-guide.toolsMissing.source: From the tools this Codex conversation started with
prompt-guide.toolsMissing.title: Tools this conversation lacks
